name: Elder Obsidian
summary: At the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, Elder Obsidian appears for the Lunar Festival. The ancestral earthen spirit greets travelers among the graves claimed by the Forsaken, offering ancient wisdom and blessings.

sections.title: A Spirit at the Sepulcher
sections.body: Elder Obsidian greets travelers at the Sepulcher during the Lunar Festival. His earthen spirit brings the ancient heritage of Azeroth to Silverpine Forest. The surrounding crypts are held by the Forsaken, and feral worgen menace the forest. Yet Obsidian welcomes wayfarers of every allegiance in peace, offering a Coin of Ancestry and ancient blessings to those who seek his wisdom.

faq.answer: Elder Obsidian is an ancient earthen spirit who appears in Silverpine Forest during the Lunar Festival. He greets travelers who honor Azeroth's ancestral heritage.

faq.q: Where can Elder Obsidian be found?
faq.answer: Elder Obsidian can be found in the graveyard at the Sepulcher, a Forsaken hamlet along the road in central Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does an earthen elder appear in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, ancient elder spirits appear across Azeroth to share ancestral wisdom. Elder Obsidian meets travelers among the old graves, beyond local territorial conflicts.

faq.q: Can Alliance adventurers speak with Elder Obsidian?
faq.answer: Yes. Festival elders welcome travelers of every faction. The Sepulcher is held by the Forsaken, so Alliance adventurers must pass the hostile guards nearby to reach Elder Obsidian.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can glimpse the primordial past of your stone-hewn ancestors by speaking with an earthen spirit like Elder Obsidian.
As an Alliance pilgrim, you must tread carefully to reach Elder Obsidian at the Sepulcher, a Forsaken settlement.
